Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.270/2024 registered at Police Station Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal (M.P.) under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(n), 120-B, 34 of IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Applicant is in detention since 04.12.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is of kidnapping the minor prosecutrix and committing rape upon her.
On the basis of which, offence under the aforesaid sections has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant is in jail since 04.12.2024.
It is further submitted that at the time of incident, age of the prosecutrix was 16 years 2 months.
She was the consenting party.
She stayed with the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62123 2 MCRC-43666-2025 applicant for about 6 months.
Conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was minor.
Prosecutrix in her Court statement has deposed against the applicant.
DNA report is also positive.
At this stage, minute appreciation of evidence cannot be done.
Hence, he prayed for rejection of this bail application.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
